channel.title: Prepared Foods Magazine - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Prepared Foods Magazine (preparedfoods.com)

item.title: Sargento Turns Up Heat on Cheese Snacks
item.description: Sargento is expanding its natural cheese portfolio with spicy sliced cheeses and new Balanced Breaks Cheese + Crunch Mixes designed for bold snacking occasions. The launches reflect growing demand for customizable heat levels, craveable textures and convenient protein-forward formats in the dairy aisle.

item.title: Impossible Foods CEO Peter McGuinness to Depart
item.description: Impossible Foods announced CEO Peter McGuinness will step down after nearly four years, with leadership transitioning to its three-member executive team. The company says the move comes from a position of strength as it builds momentum in plant-based protein and innovation partnerships.

item.title: good2grow Expands BIGGER Juice Line
item.description: good2grow is adding a fourth flavor to its BIGGER juice line with Watermelon Berry Twist, following strong consumer testing and sustained performance at retail. The launch highlights how larger pack sizes, kid-friendly functionality and no-added-sugar formulations can drive repeat purchase and outsized growth in the kids’ beverage space.

item.title: DripDrop Launches Zero Sugar Plus Hydration
item.description: DripDrop Hydration is expanding its portfolio with Zero Sugar Plus, a clean-label electrolyte drink mix designed for daily hydration and recovery. The new formula delivers three times the electrolytes of leading sports drinks with zero sugar and no artificial sweeteners.

item.title: 10 Flavors Set to Shape 2026 Menus
item.description: From mandarin and cherry to sweet heat and tiramisu, Tastepoint by IFF names the 10 flavors expected to influence food and beverage innovation in 2026. The list spans categories from beverages and snacks to bakery and dairy, reflecting shifting consumer tastes and global inspiration.

item.title: Vibrant Ingredients Promotes Hermanowicz to CMO
item.description: Vibrant Ingredients has promoted Jillian Hermanowicz to chief marketing officer following her leadership of the company’s 2025 rebrand. In the role, she will continue to oversee enterprise marketing, insights and communications while partnering closely with sales and R&D to support growth.

item.title: Hain Celestial Sells North American Snacks Unit
item.description: Hain Celestial Group has agreed to sell its North American snacks business to Snackruptors Inc. for $115 million in cash. The move supports a streamlined portfolio focused on higher-margin core categories, including tea, yogurt and baby and kids.

item.title: Oikos and Light + Fit Launch REMIX Yogurts
item.description: Danone’s Oikos and Light + Fit brands are expanding yogurt’s role as a snackable treat with the launch of REMIX, a mix-in line pairing creamy bases with layered, indulgent textures. The launch reflects growing consumer interest in desserts that deliver both enjoyment and functional nutrition, including high protein and controlled calories.

item.title: RECOVER 180 Expands Lineup With New Flavors
item.description: RECOVER 180 is expanding its organic hydration lineup with the launch of Tropical Ice and Orange Cream. The new flavors reinforce the brand’s focus on clean, functional hydration for athletes and active consumers seeking better-for-you alternatives to traditional sports drinks.

item.title: Signature Sauces Drive Menu Innovation in 2025
item.description: Datassential’s latest sauces, condiments and dressings report shows growing consumer demand for signature flavors that create emotional connection and repeat visits. With fewer than half of operators offering a signature sauce, the category presents a major opportunity for menu differentiation and retail crossover.
